aiResearchSummary.text: MTailor is focused on developing methods for creating garments by capturing images of individuals to determine their measurements, eliminating the need for traditional tape measure techniques. This approach aims to streamline the process of making custom-fit clothing, enhancing convenience and efficiency for users. The research emphasizes innovative garment production through advanced image capture technology.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $8,880,011 to $25,851,894, a 2.91x increase.
